title: 歴史研究者によるレビュー
html:
07 Review

入力: ステップ06の出力。出力: out/xiaozong_review.html（ブラウザで開きます。オフラインで動きます。Download Results で JSON ファイルを保存します）。コード: build.py。

ダウンロードした JSON は decisions/ に置きます。ステップ08は、そこにあるすべてのファイルを読みます。事前選択はなく、各カードは確認するページ画像 (01_render/out/seq-NNNN.png) を示しています。

カード 内容 件数
A 失われた日付の区切りか。記事の中の干支が空の日を指し、その前に空白がない 3
B （オフ: ステップ06は今、フラグつきの干支を規則で決める） 0
C 暦と違う朔 2

2026-11-10 の状況: 5枚のカードすべてに著者が回答し (decisions/xiaozong_review_results_2026-11-10.json)、ステップ08で適用しました。

  • 乙卯 (juan 64) と辛亥 (juan 123): はい、そこから新しい記事が始まる。切れ目は2つ。
  • 上以戊申紀元 (juan 224): いいえ、文の一部。
  • 弘治十四年八月の朔: ページには丙午とある（OCR は丙子と読んだ）。弘治十五年六月の朔: 辛丑（OCR は辛卯と読んだ）。どちらも今は暦と一致する。

あわせて適用したもの: decisions/page_check_2026-11-10.json。著者の依頼で Claude がページ画像から読み取った訂正1件（己未科は癸巳六科）で、著者の確認を待っています。

レビューページ

レビューページを開く。歴史研究者が見たままのものです。カードは5枚で、あらかじめ選んだ答えはありません。（レビューページは英語です。）

# /// script
# requires-python = ">=3.11"
# ///
"""Step 07. Build the review page: the cases a rule cannot decide.

In:   06_dates/out/dated.jsonl, dividers.csv, shuo_check.csv
Out:  out/xiaozong_review.html   one self-contained page; open it in a browser,
                                 answer, click Download Results
      out/items.json             the same items as data
A person's answers are saved as JSON into  07_review/decisions/ .  Step 08 reads
every file there and applies the answers by script.  Nothing is typed into the
data by hand.

Three kinds of card:
  A. Lost divider?   A 干支 inside a record names an empty day, but there is no
     blank before it and no run of days.  Cut there or not.
  B. Flagged 干支.   Switched off (INCLUDE_FLAGGED).  Since 2026-11-10 step 06 settles
     these by rule: corrected when one empty day fits, otherwise "not a date".
     They can be found in the table by their flag or note.
  C. 朔 that differs from the calendar.
Every card lists the 干支 of the dated record before and of the dated record
after, with their dates, so the reader can see what would fit between them.
Nothing is pre-selected, and the page does not say which answer the program
expects.  The page images are in 01_render/out/ (file name given on each card).

Uses the human-eval-review builder.
Run:  uv run 07_review/build.py
"""
import collections
import csv
import datetime
import html
import json
import pathlib
import sys

HERE = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = HERE.parent
sys.path.insert(0, str(BASE / "lib"))
sys.path.insert(0, str(pathlib.Path("human-eval-review/scripts")))
import ganzhi  # noqa: E402
import manifest  # noqa: E402
import reign_calendar  # noqa: E402
from review_builder import ReviewBuilder  # noqa: E402

D6 = BASE / "06_dates" / "out"
OUT = HERE / "out"


def month_name(r):
    return f"{r['era']}{r['year']}年{'閏' if r['leap'] else ''}{r['month']}月"


ANCHORED = ("own", "header", "restored")
INCLUDE_FLAGGED = False     # the "not a date" records are ruled on by rule (step 06), not by card


def describe(r):
    """干支 and date of a record that carries its own day."""
    if r is None:
        return "none (start or end of the book)"
    return (f"{r['gz']}  ({month_name(r)} day {r['lunar_day']}, {r['gregorian']}; record {r['rid']}: "
            f"{r['text'][:14]}…)")


def neighbours(recs, i, include_self):
    """The dated record before position i (or at i) and the next one after it."""
    start = i if include_self else i - 1
    before = next((recs[k] for k in range(start, -1, -1) if recs[k]["date_from"] in ANCHORED), None)
    after = next((recs[k] for k in range(i + 1, len(recs)) if recs[k]["date_from"] in ANCHORED), None)
    return before, after


def main() -> None:
    recs = [json.loads(l) for l in open(D6 / "dated.jsonl", encoding="utf-8")]
    by_rid = {r["rid"]: (i, r) for i, r in enumerate(recs)}
    months = reign_calendar.months()
    first_of = {(m["era"], m["year"], m["month"], m["leap"]): m for m in months}
    taken = {r["jdn"] for r in recs if r["precision"] == "day"}
    stamp = datetime.date.today().isoformat()
    rb = ReviewBuilder(title="明孝宗實錄 from OCR: cases for review",
                       subtitle="Lost dividers, flagged 干支, and 朔 that differ from the calendar",
                       lang="zh-Hant", cjk=True,
                       result_filename=f"xiaozong_review_results_{stamp}.json",
                       storage_key=f"xiaozong-review-{stamp}")
    n = collections.Counter()

    # A. proposed dividers
    for c in csv.DictReader(open(D6 / "dividers.csv", encoding="utf-8")):
        if c["status"] != "proposed":
            continue
        i, r = by_rid[c["rid"]]
        left, rest = c["context"].split("【")
        gz, right = rest.split("】")
        it = rb.add_item(id=f"cut|{c['rid']}|{c['pos']}|{c['ganzhi']}|{c['jdn']}",
                         heading=f"A. Lost divider?  {month_name(r)} · juan {r['juan']}",
                         source=f"…{html.escape(left)}<mark>{html.escape(gz)}</mark>{html.escape(right)}…",
                         source_html=True)
        before, after = neighbours(recs, i, include_self=True)
        it.add_context("Previous 干支", describe(before))
        it.add_context("This 干支", f"{gz}  (it would be day {int(c['jdn']) - first_of[(r['era'], r['year'], r['month'], r['leap'])]['first_jdn'] + 1}, {c['gregorian']}; that day has no record now)")
        it.add_context("Next 干支", describe(after))
        it.add_context("Inside record", f"{c['rid']}")
        it.add_context("Page image", f"01_render/out/{r['seq']}.png (the record starts on this page)")
        it.add_question(type="boolean", prompt="Does a new record start at the marked 干支?",
                        labels={"yes": "Yes, cut here", "no": "No, it is part of the sentence"}, notes=True)
        n["A_lost_divider"] += 1

    # B. flagged 干支
    for i, r in enumerate(recs):
        if not INCLUDE_FLAGGED or "not taken as a date" not in r["flags"] or "干支 " not in r["flags"]:
            continue
        M = first_of[(r["era"], r["year"], r["month"], r["leap"])]
        prev = next((x["jdn"] for x in reversed(recs[:i]) if x["precision"] == "day" and x.get("month") == r["month"] and x["year"] == r["year"] and x["date_from"] != "inherited"), M["first_jdn"] - 1)
        nxt = next((x["jdn"] for x in recs[i + 1:] if x["precision"] == "day" and x["date_from"] != "inherited" and x["jdn"] > prev), M["last_jdn"] + 1)
        nxt = min(nxt, M["last_jdn"] + 1)
        read = r["gz_as_read"]
        it = rb.add_item(id=f"gz|{r['rid']}",
                         heading=f"B. Flagged 干支  {month_name(r)} · juan {r['juan']}",
                         source=f"<mark>{html.escape(read)}</mark>{html.escape(r['text'][2:70])}…", source_html=True)
        it.add_context("Problem", r["flags"])
        before, after = neighbours(recs, i, include_self=False)
        it.add_context("Previous 干支", describe(before))
        it.add_context("This 干支, as read", read)
        it.add_context("Next 干支", describe(after))
        it.add_context("Page image", f"01_render/out/{r['seq']}.png")
        q = it.add_question(type="single", allow_none=False, notes=True,
                            prompt="Which day is it? (Check the page image. Write another 干支 in the notes if none fits.)")
        for d in range(max(prev, M["first_jdn"]), min(nxt, M["last_jdn"]) + 1):
            g = ganzhi.of_jdn(d)
            if (g[0] == read[0] or g[1] == read[1]) and (d not in taken or d in (prev, nxt)):
                q.add_candidate(id=g, label=g, title=f"{reign_calendar.gregorian(d)}, day {d - M['first_jdn'] + 1} of the month"
                                + ("" if d not in taken else " (already has records)"))
        q.add_candidate(id="as-read", label=f"{read} is right", title="The page really says this; leave it flagged")
        q.add_candidate(id="not-a-date", label="Not a date", title="These two characters are not the day of the record")
        n["B_flagged_ganzhi"] += 1

    # C. 朔
    for s in csv.DictReader(open(D6 / "shuo_check.csv", encoding="utf-8")):
        if s["agree"] == "1":
            continue
        i, r = by_rid[s["rid"]]
        it = rb.add_item(id=f"shuo|{s['rid']}", heading=f"C. 朔  {s['header_as_read']} · juan {s['juan']}",
                         source=html.escape(r["text"][:60]) + "…", source_html=True)
        before, after = neighbours(recs, i, include_self=False)
        it.add_context("Previous 干支", describe(before))
        it.add_context("Text", f"{s['ganzhi_as_read']}朔")
        it.add_context("Next 干支", describe(after))
        it.add_context("Calendar", f"{s['calendar_first_day']} is the first day ({s['note']})")
        it.add_context("Page image", f"01_render/out/{r['seq']}.png")
        q = it.add_question(type="single", notes=True, prompt="What does the page say?")
        q.add_candidate(id=s["calendar_first_day"], label=s["calendar_first_day"], title="The OCR misread it; the page agrees with the calendar")
        q.add_candidate(id="as-read", label=s["ganzhi_as_read"], title="The page really says this")
        n["C_shuo"] += 1

    OUT.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
    rb.save_html(str(OUT / "xiaozong_review.html"))
    (OUT / "items.json").write_text(rb.to_json() + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
    numbers = {**dict(n), "cards": sum(n.values()), "storage_key": f"xiaozong-review-{stamp}"}
    manifest.write(HERE, [D6 / "dated.jsonl", D6 / "dividers.csv", D6 / "shuo_check.csv"],
                   [OUT / "xiaozong_review.html", OUT / "items.json"], numbers)
    print(json.dumps(numbers, ensure_ascii=False, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
